claim: llm-d-router ships a first-party, built-in 'file-discovery' EndpointDiscovery plugin (type file-discovery, disabled by default) explicitly designed as 'an alternative to Kubernetes-based endpoint discovery for deployments that run the EPP without a controller manager (bare metal, Slurm, Ray, local development).'
stance_target: feasibility of running llm-d-router EPP against non-Kubernetes backends without writing a discovery plugin from scratch
quoted_support: Provides an alternative to Kubernetes-based endpoint discovery for deployments that run the EPP without a controller manager (bare metal, Slurm, Ray, local development).

claim: Audited absence for gap-5: the built-in file-discovery plugin's endpoint entry schema (name, namespace, address, port, labels) has no rankIndex or DP-rank field, and no label key (e.g. 'llm-d.ai/rank', 'dp-rank') is read anywhere in plugin.go to populate EndpointMetadata.RankIndex -- every endpoint discovered this way gets RankIndex left at its Go zero-value (0), so multi-DP-rank vLLM backends are unsupported by this plugin without custom modification.
stance_target: any assumption that RankIndex/data-parallel-rank has an existing label or config carrier a non-k8s discovery author can rely on
scope_conditions: llm-d-router file-discovery plugin schema and implementation, searched plugin.go full text for 'rank'
quoted_support:
endpoints:
  - name: <string>              # required -- unique within the file
    namespace: <string>         # optional -- defaults to "default"
    address: <IPv4>             # required -- must be a valid IPv4 address
    port: <string>              # required -- integer 1-65535 as a string
    labels:                     # optional -- arbitrary key/value labels

claim: Running EPP in file-discovery mode (no Kubernetes controller manager) explicitly disables the InferenceModelRewrite and InferenceObjective reconcilers and prevents any k8s-notification-source plugin from binding, with the runner emitting a startup log naming the inactive features.
stance_target: feature parity gap between Kubernetes-backed and file-discovery-backed EPP deployments
quoted_support: File-discovery mode runs the EPP without a Kubernetes controller manager, so several K8s-only features are inactive: the InferenceModelRewrite and InferenceObjective reconcilers do not run, and any k8s-notification-source plugin in the data layer config will not bind.

claim: A distinct 'multicluster-file-discovery' plugin variant discovers whole peer clusters as endpoints (reached by gateway host), permitting RFC-1123 hostnames rather than only IPv4 literals, and supports out-of-band metrics scraping via metricsAddress/metricsPort entry labels.
stance_target: range of non-k8s discovery topologies llm-d-router already anticipates
quoted_support: multicluster-file-discovery is the cluster-scoped variant: it discovers peer clusters as endpoints, differing from the pod file discovery only in address validation. A cluster is reached by its gateway host, so an address may be an RFC-1123 hostname or an IP, not only an IPv4 pod address.
